en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a European spa town or resort city built on a hillside. In the foreground and mid‑ground are rows of ornate late‑19th‑century buildings lining a broad tree‑planted boulevard or promenade. On the right stands a prominent synagogue‑like structure with two square towers topped by onion domes and a large rose window over the entrance. Behind the street, villas and grand hotels climb the wooded slope, with a church or chapel and other buildings at the top of the hill. The streets are relatively quiet with only a few pedestrians and early motor vehicles or carriages visible. There is no visible printed caption or text on the image itself.
